companies.one_liner: The OS for hospital workforce management
companies.hiring_description:
YouShift is transforming how hospitals and clinics manage staff scheduling. Founded by a team of engineers and healthcare experts from Harvard, we’re building the next-generation workforce management platform for healthcare—starting with AI-powered shift scheduling.

Born from firsthand experience watching family members in medicine struggle with chaotic, burnout-inducing schedules, YouShift is on a mission to bring fairness, flexibility, and intelligence to healthcare staffing.

Unlike traditional tools that replicate spreadsheets or require manual input, YouShift leverages cutting-edge optimization algorithms and agentic AI to create shift schedules that respect both hospital needs and staff preferences. We’re replacing outdated admin-heavy workflows with a modern, automated platform that empowers doctors and nurses to have a voice in their schedules.

companies.name: DeepAware AI
companies.one_liner: Robots, parts & RL environments - delivered in 72 hrs or pickup in SF.
companies.hiring_description:
DeepAware (Silicon Valley Robotics Center) builds the full stack for physical AI — spanning hardware, data, and training.

We source and ship robots and robotics parts across the US within 72 hours: humanoid robots, quadrupeds, robotic arms, tactile sensors, cameras, and dexterous hands. Beyond hardware, we help enterprises collect teleoperation data, build reinforcement learning environments, and deploy robots into production.

Our early customers include AI data centers, industrial operations, research labs, and event producers. We're solving real problems at the intersection of AI, robotics, and supply chain — and we're moving fast.

If you're excited about building the physical automation layer for the AI era, and want to work across software, hardware, and real-world deployment — you'll fit right in at DeepAware.
companies.tech_description:
DeepAware (Silicon Valley Robotics Center) operates across three layers of the robotics stack:

**Hardware supply chain.** We source robots and parts from leading global manufacturers (Unitree, Deep Robotics, Paxini, Intel Realsense, OpenArm, and more) and run a fast-turn inventory and logistics operation — getting any SKU into US customers' hands within 72 hours.

**Data and training.** We build teleoperation data collection pipelines, simulation environments in Isaac Gym / MuJoCo, and reinforcement learning policies for manipulation and locomotion. Much of this lives at the sim-to-real boundary, which is where most of the hard engineering is.

**Deployment.** We integrate robots into real-world environments — AI data centers (cable management, inspection, thermal monitoring), industrial floors (quality inspection, material handling), and live events (interactive humanoid demos with scripted interaction flows).

Our stack includes Python, ROS2, PyTorch, Isaac Sim/Lab, custom teleoperation rigs, and integrations with inventory/logistics systems. We're a small, fast-moving team that ships.

companies.name: DoorDash
companies.hiring_description:
DoorDash is a technology company that is building the next generation of local delivery. We operate a full stack delivery service: by partnering with merchants, hiring our own drivers, and building our own logistics software, we are able to control the entire delivery experience to make it more efficient for everyone.

Our team is looking to grow with talented people who want to build much more than just a food delivery company. We help small businesses grow, give underemployed people meaningful work, and offer affordable convenience to consumers.

Our investors include Sequoia Capital, Khosla Ventures, Charles River Ventures, Andreesen Horowitz, SV Angel, Y Combinator and many others.

We're looking to expand the founding team with talented people who are excited about our mission to empower local economies and build out the world's first real-time logistics company.

DoorDash is based in San Francisco, CA.
